issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 07 uses a numeric threshold of 7500 in the WHERE clause (WHERE einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500), but the problem statement requires municipalities with more than 75,000 inhabitants (mehr als 75.000). This numeric mismatch between the problem specification and the solution may confuse students and cause incorrect reference results.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query in aufgabe07.sql to use the correct threshold of 75000 (WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000) so it matches the problem statement. Alternatively, if the intended threshold is 7,500, adjust the problem statement to reflect that value.
